definitions.explanation: A traditional saying that expresses wisdom or advice.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}には{面白|おもしろ}い{諺|ことわざ}がたくさんある。
examples.english: There are many interesting proverbs in Japan.

examples.japanese: 「{七転|ななころ}び{八起|やお}き」という{諺|ことわざ}がある。
examples.english: There is a proverb that goes 'Fall seven times, stand up eight.'

examples.japanese: {諺|ことわざ}にもあるように、「{継続|けいぞく}は{力|ちから}なり」だ。
examples.english: As the proverb says, 'Perseverance is power.'

examples.japanese: {諺|ことわざ}には{先人|せんじん}の{知恵|ちえ}が{詰|つ}まっている。{現代|げんだい}でも{通用|つうよう}するものが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Proverbs are filled with the wisdom of our ancestors. Many of them are still applicable today.

notes:
{諺|ことわざ} refers to proverbs and traditional sayings.

FAMOUS JAPANESE PROVERBS:
- {七転|ななころ}び{八起|やお}き (Fall seven times, stand up eight)
- {猿|さる}も{木|き}から{落|お}ちる (Even monkeys fall from trees)
- {継続|けいぞく}は{力|ちから}なり (Persistence is power)
- {石|いし}の{上|うえ}にも{三年|さんねん} (Three years on a stone - patience pays)
- {急|いそ}がば{回|まわ}れ (If in a hurry, go around - haste makes waste)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {諺|ことわざ}にあるように (as the proverb says)
- 〜という{諺|ことわざ}がある (there is a proverb that says ~)

SIMILAR:
- {諺|ことわざ}: proverb (traditional saying)
- {格言|かくげん}: maxim, aphorism
- {慣用|かんよう}{句|く}: idiomatic phrase
